name: lifecycle-aware round-trip benchmark
description: This record contains the complete reproducibility archive accompanying the manuscript "Auditing semantic preservation in biomedical intervention records: a lifecycle-aware round-trip benchmark under predefined FHIR, OMOP, and IEEE 1752.1 implementation configurations". The archive includes the synthetic corpus, predefined implementation configurations, scoring materials, validation evidence, source code, manifests, and documentation required to reproduce the reported audit. All numerical results and calculations correspond to the submitted manuscript. Third-party standards-related materials are retained under their original source terms and are not relicensed by the authors.
